d:
Please do not regard this text as a proper translation. At best, it is somewhere between utter rubbish and a barely acceptable translation, but closer to rubbish.
The content restriction system tried very hard, but LLM and I managed to get round it somehow. Nevertheless, one should expect the language to be toned down in some of the most explicit passages, and some scenes may have been cut-out. This is still the best I’ve managed to achieve.
The tesseract does not recognise all these little hearts and other pseudographics, so they do not appear in the translated text.
I haven’t proofread the translation. Read it on your own responsibility.
This light novel is still awaiting a competent translation.
n: [Doujinshi] [Niwakakamikiriyamodoki (ADU, Satou Kuuki)] Holy Crystal Esphére ~Peridot no Shou III~haustorium~ [Digital]
